units.source_text: 傍晚时分，源氏来到明石姬所居的冬殿。

en.t: At dusk, Genji came to the Winter Hall where the Akashi lady lived.

units.source_text: 一推开内客厅旁边走廊上的门，便有一股幽香顺着和风从帘幕中飘过来，令人感觉异常幽雅。

en.t: As soon as he pushed open the door on the corridor beside the inner sitting room, a delicate fragrance drifted through the curtains on the gentle breeze, giving an unusually refined impression.

units.source_text: 走进室内，不见明石姬本人。

en.t: When he entered the room, the Akashi lady herself was nowhere to be seen.

units.source_text: 向四周察看，但见砚箱旁边散置着许多笔记稿，便拿起来看看。

en.t: Looking around, he saw many notes and drafts scattered beside the inkstone box, so he picked them up and looked them over.

units.source_text: 旁边有一个中国织锦制的茵褥，镶着华丽的边缘，上面放着一张美丽的琴。

en.t: Nearby was a cushion made of Chinese brocade, edged with a gorgeous border, and on it lay a beautiful koto.

units.source_text: 在一个异常精致的圆火钵内，浓重地熏着侍从香，其中又交混着衣被香，气味异常馥郁。

en.t: In an exceptionally fine round brazier, jiju incense was being burned richly, and mingled with it was the scent of robes and bedding, making the fragrance extraordinarily luxuriant.

units.source_text: 桌上还乱放着些书法草稿，字体别致，功夫很深。

en.t: Some calligraphy drafts also lay casually scattered on the table; the handwriting had a distinctive elegance and showed deep skill.

units.source_text: 不像学者所写的那样夹杂着许多难识的草书汉字，却是潇洒不拘的戏笔。

en.t: It was not like a scholar's writing, mixed with many hard-to-read cursive Chinese characters, but rather a free and graceful hand written in playful ease.

units.source_text: 就中有几首情意缠绵的古歌，是明石姬收到小女公子的答诗后喜极而作的。

en.t: Among them were several old poems full of tender feeling, composed by the Akashi lady in her great joy after receiving the young lady's reply poem.
One of them went as follows:
